title: Capital Q — Qatar demo hot-entity research pack
purpose: 5 evidence-backed seed entities for instant identity and rehearsal; never a hardcoded fake model answer
important_distinctions: Invest Qatar is not itself an ordinary VC fund
Shadi Qishta executive role is time-sensitive and needs latest authoritative verification
Organizational rehearsals must use a labeled synthetic role-based representative
Portrait image URLs are intentionally unset until permitted and verified assets are obtained

runtime_rules.lookup: Preload metadata, identity aliases, concise fact bundle, source IDs, and concise persona plan from local versioned DB or startup hot cache
runtime_rules.fast_path: 0 network calls to internet and ideally 0 database round trips for warm seeded identity resolution; full page availability measured separately
runtime_rules.cold_path: Use same generic search API for anyone else; bounded parallel multi-source public search with early first candidate
runtime_rules.accuracy: Do not present speculation as verified fact, and do not invent direct quotations, face or accent
runtime_rules.sources: References are public sources, subject to URL availability and third-party data-use terms
runtime_rules.consent: Do not clone real person face or voice; clearly label source-informed simulation

facts.claim: Director of Investments at Alchemist Doha, stated by Alchemist official team and Doha pages.

verification.basis: S12 and S13 (fetched) list "Muhannad Taslaq, Director of Investments"; S16 (Gulf Times, 2026-03-28) repeats it.

facts.claim: Alchemist Doha helps technology startups in Qatar and emerging markets access investors and scale.

verification.basis: S12: Alchemist Doha supports technology startups across MENA and emerging markets; S13 bio: "connects investors to help high-potential technology startups across MENA and emerging markets grow"; S16 describes it as a VC and investment platform for tech startups in Qatar and emerging markets.

facts.claim: His public writing emphasizes founder commitment to a single venture rather than simultaneously pitching multiple ideas.

verification.basis: S15 is LinkedIn; not directly verifiable without login; search-indexed

facts.claim: His published investor discussions advocate 30-day execution sprints, shipping continuously, customer focus and disciplined cash runway.

verification.basis: S16 (fetched): 30-day sprints, one metric, ship continuously; call top 10 customers; know exact burn rate and "date of death". S14 not accessible.
verification.note: The word "runway" is not used; the equivalent is burn rate and the date the money runs out.

facts.claim: TASMU describes him as a serial founder/mentor and angel investor.

verification.basis: S17 (fetched): "Serial Entrepreneur", "Angel Investor", mentor with Alchemist Accelerator.

What is your plan if fundraising takes twice as long?
